title: Whispers of Mara
description: *Requires Steam Version 1.7.104 to be installed* In Skyrim’s frost‑kissed shadows, the goddess of love whispers eternal vows. Whispers of Mara weaves romance, peril, and prophecy into a saga where every bond—whether relic, companion, or marriage—shapes destiny itself. Characters are presented with a touch more beauty and allure than in purely lore‑focused modlists, yet without crossing into the territory of adult‑only collections—striking a balance of immersion, elegance, and desire.
author: Tvirus5087
